summary.intent: Fix `entire explain --generate` for Codex checkpoints (empty-summary error) and clarify/fix Claude-based summary generation failures, starting with Codex support on a new branch and leaving Claude behavior for a follow-up.
summary.outcome: Codex `--generate` support was implemented, tested, committed on `codex-explain-generate`, pushed, and opened as draft PR #875; a review/lint follow-up (correct line-offset scoping vs response-item semantics, `goconst` in `compact/codex.go`) was committed and pushed. Local binary path was given for manual checkpoint testing.

repo: `AgentTypeCodex` was missing from summarizer dispatch; raw Codex JSONL (`session_meta`, `response_item`, `event_msg`) does not parse as Claude/Cursor `message` lines, so condensed transcripts were empty.
`CheckpointTranscriptStart` is stored as a raw JSONL line offset, not a response-item index—Codex scoping must not reinterpret it as response-item counts.
Existing Codex normalization lives in `transcript/compact/codex.go`; `--generate` should align with that rather than duplicating parsers.
`ClaudeGenerator` shells out to the user’s local `claude` CLI (`claude --print`); Entire does not call Anthropic’s API directly for summaries.
Scoped Codex transcripts may omit leading `session_meta`, so format detection must recognize Codex suffixes, not only full rollouts.

code.finding: `GenerateFromTranscript` errors on empty condensation; error wrapping can duplicate `failed to generate summary`.
Default generator is `ClaudeGenerator`; agent switch must include Codex alongside Gemini, Droid, OpenCode, Claude/Cursor.
`explain --generate` calls summarization from here; errors surface from summarize path.
Uses `exec.CommandContext` with the CLI context but no dedicated timeout; subprocess can block until cancel.
Codex compact normalization exists but must be wired into summarize path and detection updated for scoped transcripts.
Auto-summarization during condensation had the same Codex omission as `--generate`.

workflow: Red tests first, then implementation, then broader `go test` for affected packages.
CI lint (`golangci-lint`, e.g. `goconst`) can fail independently of review bots; pull exact Actions logs to fix the real rule.
GitHub PR review (Bugbot, Copilot) can catch semantic bugs (offset units) that unit tests might miss if scenarios are incomplete.

friction: Initial Codex scoping used response-item semantics vs stored line offsets—Bugbot/Copilot flagged a real bug.
Sandbox/worktree blocked branch creation and Go build cache without escalation.
Claude path: misleading `claude CLI failed (exit -1)` especially after Ctrl+C; no summarization timeout in Entire.
First compact→summarize integration fed normalized JSONL into a parser expecting raw Claude-style envelopes, requiring an extra parsing step for compact lines.
open_items: Claude-side `--generate`: timeouts, explicit cancel/`context.Canceled` handling, and clearer errors; reduce double-wrapped failure messages.
User manual verification of `/tmp/entire-codex-explain-fix` against demo-repo checkpoints `f8e8674105da` and `84c774a39830` (Claude checkpoint still expected to show old behavior until fixed).
